visual_style: antique parchment background with subtle grain
clean TCG UI language with a large art window

rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: Exposed, vulnerable, or stripped of covering; lacking defense or concealment.
content.ART_PROMPT: A discarded heavy robe lying crumpled on a cold stone floor, illuminated by a harsh beam of light from above, symbolizing exposure and vulnerability.
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Target player reveals their hand. Choose a card for them to discard. Draw cards equal to its LORE.
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Job 1:21 — “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will depart.”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Hebrews 4:13 — “Nothing in all creation is hidden... everything is naked and exposed before his eyes.”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Isaiah walked stripped of his sackcloth for three years as a sign to Egypt.
Peter was fishing 'naked' (stripped for work) before swimming to Jesus.
The Greek 'gymnos' often implies being poorly clad rather than fully nude.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left). EXACT CARD TYPE: ADJECTIVE. The internal top-left badge must print that exact type label and its matching white icon. EXACT RARITY: COMMON. REQUIRED COST: no cost. Copy complete geometry from reference [1]. Render every supplied field exactly once. All Hebrew/Aramaic, Greek, transliterations, glosses, senses, testament columns, and references are immutable canonical data: copy verbatim; never translate, paraphrase, approximate, decorate, or substitute them.
